exposure: Parturition status (released vs. not released fetal membranes)
cohort: Healthy pregnant cows (n=6) and parturient cows (n=9)
finding: Dermatopontin (DPT) concentration in bovine placenta decreased throughout pregnancy and was higher in the maternal part of the placenta.
mod_finding: At parturition, DPT concentration decreased in the maternal part and increased in the fetal part of the placenta.
